notes: SYNTHETIC, derived from the live capture. Kijiji hydrates the card's posted time client-side, so no server fetch can show it -- live-search-lego-toronto.html ships "<location>" plus the dot separator and an empty slot for all 40 cards. The card shells here are copied verbatim from that live capture; the posted-time node is reconstructed from the site's own listing:activation_time.* i18n strings shipped in the same capture ("{{hours}} hrs ago", "1 day ago", "{{weeks}} wks ago", aria_label "Published {{activationText}}"). The exact element and class names of the rendered node are NOT live-verified -- only its wording and its position inside listing-details are.
